youtube.title: Why Is AMBULANCE Written Backwards? 🚑 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Ambulances often have the word AMBULANCE printed in mirror image on the front. A driver ahead sees it in the rear-view mirror, which flips it so it reads correctly. That lets drivers recognise the vehicle instantly and move aside sooner.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.

#Shorts #science #facts #thehiddenwhy
